name: Friendly Chimps
summary:
Friendly Chimps

Swing, climb, and explore in Friendly Chimps, a fun social VR adventure inspired by classic movement-based monkey games. Use your arms to move through exciting maps, hang out with friends, discover secrets, and enjoy a welcoming community.

Features:

Fast and intuitive locomotion
Multiplayer social gameplay
Unique maps and environments
Cosmetics and customization
Regular updates and new content
Friendly community-focused experience
